messages:
Maya Chen: Kicking off Sycamore Health onboarding. Goal: private sandbox + embeddings pipeline for patient intake forms. Aim for pilot-ready integration with their case system in 8 weeks. Need infra, SSO, compliance, success metrics, and a one-page ROI for procurement. Add yourselves.

Oliver (Hawthorn): Oliver here (client). Key constraints: 30-day retention for test data, Splunk forwarding, and clinicians want a short demo in week 4.

Bea Rivera: I'll be the CSM. Draft success criteria: 1) SAML SSO for 10 pilot users; 2) endpoint p95 <380ms @256 tokens; 3) embeddings match baseline on holdout; 4) ops runbook and two enablement sessions.

Noah (SE): I'll own perf and ROI artifact. Prefer private VPC with KMS. Need holdout set and a small sample of forms. Sample perf command I'll run when endpoint is live:
```
./bench --endpoint https://sandbox.sycamore.redwood/api/v1/generate --concurrency 6 --seq 256 --duration 300
```

Cam (AE): Renewal note: contract review in ~11 months. If we can't show deletion + audit logs by week 6, renewal risk moves to medium. I need a concise ROI page by week 5.

onboard-bot: Attached: https://redwood-internal.docs/sycamore/onboarding/playbook \u2014 includes SSO steps, perf harness, ROI template, compliance checklist.

Bea Rivera: Action items recap:
- Noah: provision perf harness & ROI 1-pager (after endpoints)
- Infra: private sandbox + Splunk forwarding (ETA 72h)
- Oliver: share holdout set + SSO metadata (due Wed)
- Cam: prep procurement timeline (week 5)

Noah (SE): Provisioning request submitted. Will post endpoint + creds here once ready.

Oliver (Hawthorn): Sharing holdout set and SSO metadata to the shared drive now. Also scheduling clinician demo window in week 4.

Bea Rivera: Scheduling weekly sync Fridays 9am PT; first recap in 7 days. I'll draft a 5-question feedback survey after enablement. Locking thread to avoid noise; please post new action items in the meeting thread.
